text:
noah.pm: Hey team, first day here! Quick asks: I can't locate the Checkout component set in Figma (trying to wire up a prototype), and I need Product Roadmap Notion access + Research Drive. Who should I ping for invites? Any week-1 must-dos for PM/design pairing?

marta.designops: welcome @noah :tada: I can add you to the Figma org and the design Google group. Which email do you want me to use? I'll also kick off a Notion invite once you request product access via the form (link: https://notion.redwood.com/access).

noah.pm: noah@redwood.com — thanks. Also FYI the prototype errors out when I try to swap components, maybe naming mismatch.

lee.design: hey @noah, welcome! We follow an atomic naming convention in Figma (example: `atoms/input/text`, `molecules/cart/line-item`, `organisms/checkout-form`). Theres a short "Naming + Tokens" page inside the "Redwood UI v2" file that lists the canonical names. We did a rename last sprint (`btn/primary` -> `button/primary`) which might be why swaps fail.

noah.pm: good to know. Is there a canonical list I can copy into the prototype?

lee.design: Yep — once I add you to the file you can duplicate the "Tokens" page or use the component library export. I'll drop a quick cheat-sheet into the file as well.

marta.designops: Invite sent to noah@redwood.com for Figma and Google group. Notion-bot: product access pending until request form is submitted.

notion-bot: Notion invite queued for noah@redwood.com  respond to email to accept.

sam.research: Hi @noah  I'm research ops. I'll add you to the Research Drive and the participant tracker. If you want to shadow a session, I can schedule an internal 30min observation Thurs 2pm. We reimburse external participants at $15 by default; internal tests use the `internal` tag.

noah.pm: Thurs 2pm shadow works, thanks. Also where is the Checkout roadmap doc? I searched and found multiple pages.

marta.designops: Notion path is Product > Roadmap > Checkout Initiative Q3. I'll DM you the direct link. Also created a #eng-requests ticket to get you staging/prototype env access after you accept invites.

noah.pm: Accepted Figma and Notion invites, I can see the tokens page now  thanks Lee. Small issue: when I try to open the staging prototype I get a 403.

idp-bot: Detected access attempt to staging by noah@redwood.com resulting in 403. To request staging access, open a thread in #eng-requests with subject `access: staging` and include your email and the target feature/env. Add `@marta.designops` to escalate.

marta.designops: I filed the staging ticket on your behalf and pinged infra. They asked for the feature name; please reply with `checkout-cart-proto` so they can scope the access.

noah.pm: replied with feature name. Thanks everyone  excited to jump in. If anything else blocks me I'll drop a message here or DM @marta.designops.
